defects.note: numeric magic number in three IFs

defects.code:
procedure @@proc@@(p_kind in number, p_label out varchar2) is
begin
  if p_kind = 2 then
    p_label := '@@str@@'; -- @expect
  elsif p_kind = 3 then
    p_label := '@@str@@'; -- @expect
  elsif p_kind = 4 then
    p_label := '@@str@@'; -- @expect
  else
    p_label := 'unknown';
  end if;
end @@proc@@;

defects.note: string literal in the WHERE clause of three SQL statements
defects.code:
procedure @@proc@@(p_id in number) is
  l_a number;
  l_b number;
begin
  select count(*) into l_a
    from @@tab@@
   where @@col@@ = '@@str@@'; -- @expect
  select count(*) into l_b
    from @@tab2@@
   where @@col@@ = '@@str@@' -- @expect
     and id > p_id;
  update @@tab@@
     set @@col2@@ = l_a + l_b
   where @@col@@ = '@@str@@'; -- @expect
end @@proc@@;
